boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Salve spaces documented by university sources for study, making, reflection, recreation, and campus events.

cards.title: Set up in the Allen Family Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor tables when your group needs to compare notes, print, or pivot between individual and collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A flexible first-floor library base for solo or shared coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve identifies the Allen Family Learning Commons as a first-floor space with individual and collaborative work areas, study seating, services, and events.
cards.access_notes: Located in McKillop Library; check library access information before visiting.

cards.title: Book Study Room 217 for a focused group session
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, second floor
cards.notes: Reserve this named second-floor study room when you need a defined table space for a project meeting or shared review.
cards.short_summary: A specific library study room for planned small-group work.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library’s floor-plan page lists Study Room 217 on the second floor among group and individual study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Study-room availability and booking rules are managed by McKillop Library.

cards.title: Make a prototype in the library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a course or club idea to the second floor and ask library staff about the Cricut, button maker, laminator, and supplies.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on library workspace with making tools and supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve lists a Makerspace on McKillop Library’s second floor with a Cricut machine, laminating machine, button maker, and craft supplies.
cards.access_notes: Confirm equipment availability and any staff guidance with McKillop Library.

cards.title: Use the third floor when silence matters
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, designated silent floor
cards.notes: Choose a private carrel or a quiet study room upstairs when you need uninterrupted reading, drafting, or exam preparation.
cards.short_summary: McKillop’s designated silent floor with carrels and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve designates McKillop Library’s third floor as its silent floor and lists private individual-study carrels plus study rooms 304 and 306.
cards.access_notes: Observe the library’s stated total-silence expectation on this floor.

cards.entity_name: University Archives & Special Collections Reading Room
cards.title: Plan a primary-source stop at the archives reading room
cards.subtitle: McKillop Library, Room 305
cards.notes: For a research project with campus or local-history material, contact Archives ahead and use the listed reading room on the third floor.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room for archival and special-collections research.
cards.evidence_claim: McKillop Library’s floor-plan page lists the University Archives & Special Collections office and Reading Room in Room 305 on the third floor.
cards.access_notes: Contact University Archives & Special Collections for research access and handling requirements.

cards.title: Take a study-and-reset break in Mercy Commons
cards.subtitle: Garden level of Our Lady of Mercy Chapel
cards.notes: Use the commons for a low-key study break, a snack, or time with friends; Center for Spiritual Life programming is based here.
cards.short_summary: A campus commons for studying, relaxing, service, and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve says Mercy Commons is a Center for Spiritual Life space where students can study, cook, relax with friends, or grab a snack.
cards.access_notes: The Center for Spiritual Life publishes academic-year hours; it is closed Saturdays.

cards.title: Pause at Our Lady of Mercy Chapel
cards.subtitle: 22 Ochre Point Ave
cards.notes: Visit respectfully for quiet reflection or attend a listed service; the first floor includes a prayer and meditation space for people of all faiths.
cards.short_summary: A central campus chapel with regular services and reflective space.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve describes the chapel as a central campus location with regular academic-year services and a first-floor interfaith prayer room for quiet prayer and meditation.
cards.access_notes: Respect scheduled services and the reflective purpose of the chapel.

cards.title: Meet up at Rodgers Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 1 Lawrence Ave
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule, then use the building’s gymnasium, fitness center, dance studio, or hall of fame area as appropriate.
cards.short_summary: Salve’s named hub for athletic and recreational facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s venue page identifies Rodgers Recreation Center as housing the gymnasium, fitness center, dance studio, training rooms, and hall of fame area.
cards.access_notes: Facility access and recreation schedules may vary; check with Salve Athletics or the venue calendar.

cards.title: Look for campus programming on O’Hare Lawn
cards.subtitle: Beside O’Hare Academic Building
cards.notes: Watch orientation and campus-event listings for activities held under the tent on the lawn, then join only events open to your audience.
cards.short_summary: A named lawn used for Salve orientation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s New Seahawk Orientation schedule places a jazz brunch, student-experience program, and wellness programming in the Orientation Tent on O’Hare Lawn.
cards.access_notes: This is an event space; access depends on the current program and setup.

cards.title: Catch a campus baseball event at Reynolds Field
cards.subtitle: Lawrence Avenue
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar before heading over to see whether a baseball game, clinic, or other listed event is scheduled at the field.
cards.short_summary: Salve’s named home field for university baseball.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve identifies Brother Michael Reynolds Field as the home of the university’s baseball team and lists athletics events there.
cards.access_notes: Event attendance and field access depend on the athletics schedule and posted event details.
